title: Linearity of the normalized coefficient restriction comparison
statement: Let B, eR, G and hG be as in [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding]. For h:S→T and a module-valued pro-etale sheaf N on S, let M=h_* E_S(N), P=E_T(h_*N), and let e:M.X≅P.X be the additive isomorphism obtained by restricting the underlying-sheaf encoding isomorphism at S and composing with its inverse at T. Then act_M followed by e.hom equals Λ_T acting on e.hom followed by act_P, where Λ_T is the pullback of the continuous-function condensed ring. Thus this particular additive isomorphism is linear.

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemma 5.4.1; sectionwise coefficient encoding

proof.text: Reuse encodingPushforwardIso and push_action, the proved sectionwise direct-image construction in Sheaf.Paper.FiniteDiscreteRestrictionEncoding. Its action calculation uses the existing coefficient-unit compatibility theorem; no new compatibility assumption is introduced.

Define inverseForgetIso from sheafEncodingForgetIso. Naturality of the fixed equality hG shows that encodingPushforwardIso followed by this forgetful comparison on the source is the comparison on the target. The counit of scalar restriction along the ring isomorphism has identity underlying additive map. Naturality therefore identifies inverseForgetIso composed with the inverse encoding unit with finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalenceForgetIso.

For M=h_*E_S(N) and P=E_T(h_*N), compose the inverse-encoding direct-image isomorphism with the source inverse unit and target unit, then lift the resulting map through the fully faithful target inverse encoding. Apply naturality of inverseForgetIso and cancel its invertible component. The two unit identities and the preceding direct-image compatibility identify the lifted underlying map with the specified normalized additive restriction comparison. Apply Mod.act_hom to the lifted module morphism.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionForgetIso_linear
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ T) (N : FiniteDiscreteProEtaleSheaves B S) :
    let M := (lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) h).obj
      ((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG S).functor.obj N)
    let P := (finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG T).functor.obj
      ((ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)) h).obj N)
    let e := (finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionForgetIso B eR G hG h).app N
    Mod.act M.X ≫ e.hom = (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) T) ◁
      e.hom ≫ Mod.act P.X
